title: Million-Record Population Pipeline — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Loads large datasets in batches, deduplicates entries, validates provenance, and reports real record counts. Big datasets load in controlled batches: duplicates are removed, every record's provenance is validated, and the reported count is the real loaded count. Framing: "God Mode" here means an ambitious engineering target — maximum useful capability, broad interoperability, deep automation, and rigorous verification — NOT unlimited intelligence or guaranteed success. "Boundless" means the capacity to extend this system, not a claim that its records or capabilities are already infinite. Record counts reported are actual populated counts; generated records are labeled "generated" and never mixed with sourced facts.
